bandReport.notes: 34 questions, Q33-Q66, contiguous with no gaps and no duplicates. Page map (0-based PDF index -> printed page number): p07->15 (Q33-40), p08->17 (Q41-46), p09->19 (Q47-51), p10->21 (Q52-56), p11->23 (Q57-60), p12->25 (Q61-66). NOTE the printed page numbers are ODD ONLY, stepping by 2 — this PDF contains only the English pages; the even printed pages are the Hindi translation and are not in the render (Hindi bleed-through from the reverse side is visible on every scan and was ignored). BAND EDGES: the first question on my first page, Q33, is COMPLETE — it opens at the top of the left column of p07 with a full stem and all four options, nothing continues from p06, so B1 should end at Q32. The last question on my last page, Q66, is COMPLETE — its four options finish in the right column of p12 above the footer, nothing spills to p13, so B3 should begin at Q67. NO SHARED 'Directions:' / shared-code block anywhere in this band: every one of the 34 questions prints its own four options. COLUMN-FLOW HAZARD HIT ONCE, on p08: Q44's stem and its two numbered statements end at the foot of the LEFT column and its 'Select the correct answer using the code given below.' line plus its four options are printed at the TOP of the RIGHT column of the same page — they sit physically beside Q41's option block but belong to Q44 by column flow. Every other question on the band keeps its stem and options together in one column. NOTHING VISIBLE FROM A NEIGHBOURING BAND: no fragment of Q32 appears on p07 and no fragment of Q67 appears on p12. CATALOG GAPS (3 flagged, see per-question flags): (1) no subtopic for world REGIONAL/political geography — which countries make up a named region (Q40, Arabian Peninsula) — filed under 'World — Coordinates, Time and Place'; (2) no subtopic for world CONTINENTAL physical geography — continents, their relief and highest peaks (Q41, Antarctica) — same fallback; (3) no subtopic for Indian PAINTING/mural art of the ancient-medieval period, History offers only 'Temple and Rock-Cut Architecture' (Q49, early Chola painting at Brihadisvara) — filed under the dynasty subtopic 'Other Medieval Kingdoms (Chola, Rajput, Ahom, Sikh)'. PAGE DEFECTS / PRINTED ODDITIES, all transcribed as printed and individually flagged: Q38 prints 'Raise of' rather than 'Rise of' in options (b) and (c) (verified at 6x); Q55 asks which is NOT ferromagnetic and prints more than one option that is arguably non-ferromagnetic — a possible multiple-correct defect for adjudication, options verified at 7x; Q58 statement 3 is printed ungrammatically as 'every adult consenting individuals'; Q62 option (a) prints the non-standard term 'Flavi-ribo virus' rather than 'Flavivirus' (verified at 10x). OPTION-ORDER WARNING for the deriver: FOUR questions print their code options OUT OF THE USUAL ASCENDING ORDER, and each was re-cropped at 8x specifically to confirm the label->text pairing — Q57 (c)='1, 2 and 3', (d)='2 only'; Q58 (c)='1, 2 and 3', (d)='1 only'; Q61 (c)='1, 2 and 3', (d)='1 and 3 only'; and Q50/Q52 use the 'How many of the above statements is/are correct?' form whose options are counts (Q50: 1/2/3/None; Q52: 1/2/All/None) rather than the usual '1 only / 2 only' code. Do not normalise any of these. All 34 questions have exactly four options labelled A-D; every label->text pairing was re-checked against the page after transcription per Rule 1.
